title: 第一卷 正文第11章 燃血丹第一卷 正文第12章 玄火剑指
content_zh:
虽然这样想，但楚山心中还是有一丝不安，为了以防万一，他从储物玉佩中拿出一颗暗红色的丹药，暗中递到楚浩辰手中，低声嘱咐道：“如果出现意外，立刻服下此丹。”
“父亲放心，区区一个灵者六重天的废物，我连武技都不用施展，就能将其虐杀！”楚浩辰自信无比地说道。
话虽如此，但为了让楚山安心，楚浩辰还是将丹药收下。
楚山微微点了点头，手掌一翻，从储物玉佩拿出一份生死状，朗声道：“生死对决，两厢情愿，生死无怨。双方签下生死状，就可以开始对决了！”
楚浩辰迫不及待地在生死状上签下名字，然后一脸挑衅地看向楚凌天。
楚凌天走到楚山面前，在生死状上签下自己的名字。
楚山将生死状举过头顶，向围观众人展示了一下。
随后，他退到一边，宣布道：“楚凌天、楚浩辰生死对决的，正式……”
“等一下！”楚凌天突然打断了他。
楚浩辰眉毛一掀，嘲弄道：“后悔要进行生死对决了？晚了！”
楚凌天冷笑一声：“后悔？怎么可能。我只是要强调一下，这场生死对决不光是你我的私怨，还关系着风云城楚家分支的学宫考核名额。谁赢，谁就是楚家分支的第一天才，可以代表风云城楚家分支，参加今日的学宫考核。”
“没错，谁赢谁就是楚家分支第一天才。”楚浩辰不耐烦地说道，“行了，赶紧开始吧。解决了你，本少还要忙着参加学宫考核呢。”
楚山宣布道：“生死对决，正式开始！”
话音落下，楚浩辰一步跨出，灵师一重天初期的修为全力爆发，气势席卷四周。
在灵武丹的辅助下，楚浩辰终于在昨日突破至灵师一重天。虽然只是堪堪达到了灵师一重天初期，但足以傲视风云城年轻一辈。
据他所知，此次参加学宫考核的其他人，修为最高只有灵者九重天中期。踏入灵师境的，只有他一人。
“风云城楚家不愧是郡城楚家的分支，底蕴果然深厚，竟能培养出灵师境的后辈。”
“楚浩辰这次要出尽风头了。”
“如此年纪，修为便达到了灵师一重天，未来前途不可限量。”
……

围观众人发出阵阵惊叹。
石台上，赵松柏、陈峰、李延鹤，都微微点了点头。
虽然楚浩辰的气息有些虚浮，但确实达到了灵师一重天初期。放眼整个流云郡的考核者中，勉强可以排在上等了。
听到众人的夸赞，楚浩辰不禁有些飘飘然，一脸得意地望向楚凌天：“还要打吗？看在你我同是楚家人的份上，本少给你一个自裁的机会。”
楚凌天轻蔑一笑：“还以为在主家的资源扶持下，你的修为已经达到了灵者一重天中期，甚至更高。却没想到，只是堪堪踏入灵者一重天初期而已，真是废物。”
楚浩辰脸色瞬间阴冷下来，声音冰寒道：“本想让你自裁，给你一个痛快。但你却非要作死！本少今日，定要将你虐杀！让你受尽痛苦而死！”
说罢，楚浩辰化作一道残影，朝着楚凌天爆射而去。
“嘭！”
楚浩辰来得快，去得更快。
在他袭至楚凌天面前时，楚凌天闪电般砸出一拳，直接将他砸飞。
他的双手硬接楚凌天一拳，此时还在微微发颤。
“灵师一重天中期？这怎么可能！”楚浩辰双眼暴睁，脸上露出不敢置信之色。
他能这么快突破至灵师一重天初期，是因为有主家赐下的灵武丹。楚凌天一个被抽离了血脉的废人，怎么可能比他修炼的还快？
content_en:
Although he thought this way, Chu Shan still felt a little uneasy. Just in case, he took out a dark red pill from his storage jade pendant, secretly handed it to Chu Haochen's hand, and whispered: "If something unexpected happens, take this pill immediately."
"Father, don't worry, I can kill a mere waste from the sixth level of the Spiritual Realm without even using any martial arts!" Chu Haochen said with great confidence.
Even so, in order to make Chu Shan feel at ease, Chu Haochen still accepted the elixir.
Chu Shan nodded slightly, flipped his palm, took out a certificate of life and death from the jade pendant in his storage, and said loudly: "A duel between life and death, mutual consent, no grudges between life and death. After both parties sign the certificate of life and death, the duel can begin!"
Chu Haochen couldn't wait to sign his name on the life and death certificate, and then looked at Chu Lingtian with a provocative look.
Chu Lingtian walked up to Chu Shan and signed his name on the certificate of life and death.
Chu Shan raised the life and death form above his head and showed it to the onlookers.
Then, he stepped aside and announced: "The life and death showdown between Chu Lingtian and Chu Haochen is official..."
"Wait a minute!" Chu Lingtian suddenly interrupted him.
Chu Haochen raised his eyebrows and mocked: "Do you regret having a life-and-death duel? It's too late!"
Chu Lingtian sneered: "Regret? How is it possible? I just want to emphasize that this life and death duel is not only a personal grudge between you and me, but also related to the Fengyun City Chu family branch's academy assessment quota. Whoever wins will be the top genius of the Chu family branch and can represent the Fengyun City Chu family branch to participate in today's academy assessment."
"That's right, whoever wins will be the number one genius in the Chu family branch." Chu Haochen said impatiently, "Okay, let's start quickly. After I deal with you, I will still be busy taking the Academy exam."
Chu Shan announced: "The life-and-death showdown has officially begun!"
After the words fell, Chu Haochen took a step forward, and the spiritual master's first-level cultivation exploded with all his strength, sweeping the surroundings with aura.
With the help of Lingwu Dan, Chu Haochen finally broke through to the first level of spiritual master yesterday. Although he has only reached the early stage of the first level of spiritual master, he is enough to look down upon the younger generation in Fengyun City.
As far as he knew, the other people who participated in the academy assessment this time had the highest level of cultivation, only the middle level of the Nine Heavens of the Spiritual Realm. He is the only one who has entered the spiritual master realm.
"The Chu family of Fengyun City is worthy of being a branch of the Chu family of the county. It has a profound foundation and can actually cultivate descendants of the spiritual master realm."
"Chu Haochen is going to steal the show this time."
"At such an age, his cultivation has reached the first level of a spiritual master, and his future prospects are limitless."
…
The onlookers burst into exclamation.
On the stone platform, Zhao Songbai, Chen Feng, and Li Yanhe all nodded slightly.
Although Chu Haochen's aura was a bit insubstantial, he had indeed reached the early stage of the first level of spiritual master. Looking at the assessors in Liuyun County, he can barely rank at the top.
Hearing the praises from everyone, Chu Haochen couldn't help but feel a little elated, and looked at Chu Lingtian with a proud look on his face: "Do you want to fight again? For the sake of you and me being from the Chu family, I will give you a chance to commit suicide."
Chu Lingtian smiled contemptuously: "I thought that with the support of the master's resources, your cultivation level had reached the middle stage of the first level of spiritual being, or even higher. But I didn't expect that you were only at the early stage of the first level of spiritual being. What a waste."
Chu Haochen's face turned cold in an instant, and he said in an icy voice: "I wanted you to commit suicide and give you a happy life. But you insist on seeking death! Today, I will definitely kill you! Let you die in extreme pain!"
After saying that, Chu Haochen turned into an afterimage and shot towards Chu Lingtian.
"Bang!"
Chu Haochen came and left even faster.
When he attacked Chu Lingtian, Chu Lingtian punched him like lightning and knocked him away.
His hands received a punch from Chu Lingtian, and he was still trembling slightly.
"Middle stage of the first level of spiritual master? How is this possible!" Chu Haochen's eyes widened with disbelief on his face.
He can be so fastThe reason for breaking through to the early stage of the first level of spiritual master is because of the spiritual martial arts pill given by the master. How could Chu Lingtian, a useless person who had his bloodline removed, be able to cultivate faster than him?
